spans.s: रीति f. 1. Motion, course; 2. a stream, a river; 3. a line, a boundary; 4. general way, method, manner, fashion, पुत्रादपि धनभाजां भीतिः सर्वत्रैषा विहिता रीतिः M.
; 5. usage, practice; 6. style, diction, (they are वैदर्भी, गौडी, पांचाली and लाटिका or मागधी), पदसंघटनारातिरंगसंस्थाविशेषवत् S.
; 7. brass, bell-metal; (also रीती in this sense); 8. oxide of any metal.
